reason: I already have my Toplux and reorder it when it runs out, and I don't really go shopping for a second supplement. The named lab and batch report are nice, but I'm not going to switch my routine for a brand I've never heard of.
objection: I already have something that works for me. Why add another box and another $25 a month for something new from a brand with no track record?
would_change_my_mind: A friend or a creator I trust who has taken it for a month and says it actually helped my sleep or recovery, plus a cheaper trial size so I'm not committing to a full 30 days.
